data.one_liner: A lightweight Flutter widget that detects multiple gestures simultaneously.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single widget that can recognize tap, double‑tap, long‑press, move, scale and scroll gestures. All callbacks can be used together and timings are configurable.
use_when: You need to handle several gesture types on the same widget without nesting multiple GestureDetectors.
You want simple, configurable timing for double‑tap or long‑press detection.
avoid_when: You require complex gesture arenas or custom recognizers beyond the provided set.
You prefer a fully‑tested, widely‑adopted solution from the Flutter SDK.
strengths: Supports many gesture types in one widget
weaknesses: Not a standard Flutter package, so community support may be low
